entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2615281560211505408: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.0069 +/- 0.0627 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 111.03 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 16.190, -43.122 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2615281560211505408 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 40,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.25 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Adams et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of EPIC 206215704 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021PSJ.....2..152A/abstract). Mass 0.407 +/- 0.095 solar masses from Heller et al. 2019, the stellar mass of EPIC 206215704 b's parameter set from Heller et al. 2019 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...627A..66H/abstract). Temperature 3297 +/- 73 K from Adams et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of EPIC 206215704 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,297 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc180. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,297 K and log g 5.25 (u1 0.151, u2 0.467): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
